coverage_policy.objective: Broad, auditable discovery of public AI alignment research, preserving uncertain candidates for review.
coverage_policy.completeness: No finite registry, keyword query, publisher feed, or crawler establishes that all alignment research has been collected.
coverage_policy.history: Retain discovered records indefinitely; resume bounded historical backfills each run.
known_gaps: Unindexed papers, private or paywalled material, personal sites outside the registry, missing publisher metadata, and non-English terminology.
Publisher RSS windows are finite; older archives may need additional adapters.
Scholarly keyword searches trade precision for recall and still miss papers using unfamiliar terminology.
New sources require registration and validation; source success does not imply archive completeness.

sources.name: Alignment Feed
sources.coverage_note: Secondary discovery index, including commentary and capabilities news; page-number archive is progressively traversed.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.search_query: all:"AI alignment" OR all:"AI safety" OR all:"artificial intelligence safety" OR all:"value alignment" OR all:"preference alignment" OR all:"deceptive alignment" OR all:"mechanistic interpretability" OR all:"scalable oversight" OR all:"AI control" OR all:"reward hacking" OR all:"reward tampering" OR all:"specification gaming" OR all:"goal misgeneralization" OR all:"alignment faking" OR all:"weak-to-strong" OR all:"constitutional AI" OR all:"eliciting latent knowledge" OR all:"sleeper agents" OR all:"mesa optimization" OR all:"mesa-optimization" OR all:"inner alignment" OR all:"outer alignment" OR all:"superalignment" OR all:"evaluation awareness" OR all:"model organisms" OR all:"chain of thought faithfulness" OR all:"chain-of-thought monitorability" OR all:"AI scheming" OR all:"AI sandbagging" OR all:"corrigibility" OR all:"wireheading" OR ti:scheming OR ti:sandbagging OR ((ti:alignment OR ti:interpretability OR ti:honesty OR ti:deception OR ti:oversight OR ti:shutdown) AND (all:"language model" OR all:"AI agent" OR all:"reinforcement learning" OR all:"artificial intelligence" OR all:"neural network"))
sources.coverage_note: Cross-category keyword search without a cs.AI/cs.LG restriction; new/updated papers plus year-partitioned historical pagination back to 1991. Query recall is incomplete. During API outages a visibly degraded, keyword-matched RSS backup covers the current announcement window in five categories; archive cursors do not advance.

sources.name: OpenReview
sources.coverage_note: Public API v2 paper submissions matching exact phrases, with progressive pagination. API v1 venues and work without configured terminology may be missing; search result ceilings are reported explicitly.

sources.name: Alignment Forum
sources.coverage_note: Public Alignment Forum posts, including informal research and discussion, with date-based archive and catch-up cursors.

sources.name: LessWrong
sources.coverage_note: All public posts are scanned as discovery candidates, avoiding reliance on incomplete alignment tags; relevance labels distinguish research from unrelated discussion.

sources.name: METR
sources.coverage_note: Publisher RSS includes evaluations and methodology; historical coverage is bounded by the publisher feed.

sources.name: Anthropic Alignment Science
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-owned article cards from the current index, progressively fetched; publication dates come from article metadata and bylines.

sources.name: Redwood Research
sources.coverage_note: Public Substack archive paginated beyond its finite RSS window. Older work absent from the archive may be discovered through other indexes.

sources.name: Transformer Circuits
sources.coverage_note: All article cards on the publisher historical index, with its explicit data-date publication dates and summaries. Fetches the lightweight index rather than embedding-heavy article HTML.

sources.name: FAR.AI
sources.coverage_note: Research collection URLs in the publisher sitemap, progressively fetched. Original publication bylines override website-migration dates.

sources.name: Apollo Research
sources.coverage_note: Science, monitoring and governance research pages in the publisher sitemap, progressively fetched with explicit publication dates where supplied.

sources.name: Alignment Research Center
sources.coverage_note: All research-blog URLs in the publisher post sitemap, progressively fetched beyond the shorter RSS feed. Old pages rotate for metadata refresh.

sources.name: MIRI
sources.coverage_note: RSS mixes technical alignment work, policy, organizational updates and newsletters; older technical reports need separate archive indexing.

sources.name: MIRI Publications
sources.coverage_note: Technical reports and venue papers explicitly cited in the official historical bibliography, including direct PDFs absent from arXiv. Citation years are preserved as text; exact dates remain unknown unless another source provides them.

sources.name: OpenAI
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-wide feed includes safety research alongside products and company news; candidates are retained for relevance review.

sources.name: Google DeepMind
sources.coverage_note: Publisher-wide blog includes technical safety and general AI news; older history is bounded by the feed window.
